plan: Vision Zero Reimagined: A New Action Plan for Road Safety (2026), Mayor’s Office of Operations

goals.1: Remove dangerous drivers from our streets
goals.2: Promote safe, certified micromobility while curbing dangerous devices and riding behavior
goals.3: Encourage safer travel through walking, transit, micromobility, and car-share over private automobile use
goals.4: Discourage oversized vehicles and prepare for new vehicle technologies
goals.5: Expand and maintain safety-focused street designs
goals.6: Cultivate a safety culture of accountability through education and enforcement
goals.7: Leverage emerging data, technology, and analysis for smarter interventions
goals.8: Lead by example with the nation’s safest municipal fleet

marquee.t: Launch New York City’s first-ever Super Speeder program
marquee.d: Require the most extreme repeat speed violators to install Intelligent Speed Assistance devices, under the 2026 State budget.

marquee.t: Expand the implementation of Sammy’s Law
marquee.d: 20 MPH speed limits within entire neighborhoods or other defined zones across the five boroughs, alongside 15 MPH School Slow Zones at every eligible school.

marquee.t: Hardened daylighting or better at a minimum of 1,000 intersections each year
marquee.d: Safety street improvement projects, traffic signals, all-way stops and leading pedestrian intervals, prioritized by data.

marquee.t: Complete safety treatments on all Vision Zero Priority Corridors
marquee.d: Nearly 200 citywide, with protected bike lanes and other proven traffic calming where feasible.
Safety requirements, data transparency, worker protections and reforms to delivery practices and incentives.

marquee.t: Make dangerous driving a key legislative priority in Albany
marquee.d: Limit conditional licenses for drivers who routinely violate traffic laws; combat ghost plates.

marquee.t: Lead the nation in fleet safety
marquee.d: Intelligent Speed Assistance, pedestrian alerts and surround cameras across the City fleet.

marquee.t: Launch the Office of Curb Management at DOT
marquee.d: Loading zones, deliveries, and reducing double parking and parking in bike and bus lanes.

marquee.t: Traffic safety curriculum in every public school
marquee.d: Age-appropriate Vision Zero lessons in the NYC Public Schools curriculum.

marquee.t: A unified Vision Zero data warehouse
marquee.d: Crash, health, enforcement and transportation data integrated across agencies.
A connected streetlight network that detects outages and speeds repairs, including under elevated trains and highways.
